_doc: Equipment sockets (06_STYLE_ART.md section 3). Each socket is an Empty parented to a bone, placed at the bone head, tail or mid point plus offset_m. Chest and back offsets put the socket on the body surface of average_m (measured 2026-10-08: chest front y -0.145, back y +0.077 at z 1.32). offset_m is in armature rest space (metres): +X is the body's left, -Y is the body's front, +Z is up. Offsets are fixed with the rig freeze; changing one changes the contract hash.
